We are looking for a "Vibe Coder" — someone who codes with rhythm and intuition, leverages modern AI tools to move fast, and isn't afraid to experiment with the latest in Large Language Models (LLMs) and distributed systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
GenAI Development: Build and deploy applications using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures. Implement agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph.
  
  
Research & Innovation: Conduct deep-dive research on emerging GenAI trends, model architectures, and optimization techniques. Synthesize findings into technical blogs, whitepapers, or research summaries to guide the team's technical direction.
  
  
Big Data Processing: Design and implement scalable data pipelines using Apache Spark and Hadoop to handle large datasets effectively.
  
  
Business Intelligence & Reporting: Design and maintain interactive dashboards using PowerBI or MicroStrategy to visualize model outputs, track KPIs, and drive data-driven decision-making.
  
  
Prompt & Context Engineering: Optimize system prompts and context windows to ensure high-accuracy model responses.
  
  
Data Engineering & ETL: Design data pipelines with an understanding of core distributed computing concepts. Assist in ETL workflows using tools like DataStage, Postgres, or custom scripts.
  
  
Model Selection: Analyze business problems and identify the correct Machine Learning algorithm or GenAI model for the task.
  
  
Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain services on AWS (specifically EC2 for compute and RDS for storage).
  
  
Agile Collaboration: Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and use Jira for task tracking and Git for version control.
  
  
Technical Requirements
  
  

* Core Languages

Python (Must-Have): Strong proficiency for AI/ML and PySpark workflows.
  
  
Java: Solid understanding of OOPs concepts and willingness to work on Big Data integrations.
  
  

* Artificial Intelligence & GenAI

Hands-on experience (academic projects or internships) with Generative AI.
  
  
Knowledge of LangChain and LangGraph for orchestration.
  
  
Deep understanding of Prompt Engineering and Context Engineering.
  
  
Research Literacy: Ability to read, understand, and implement concepts from technical research papers (e.g., arXiv) and documentation.
  
  
Familiarity with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, ChromaDB, or Milvus) is a strong plus.
  
  

* Big Data & Data Engineering

Big Data Frameworks: Foundational knowledge of Apache Spark and the Hadoop Ecosystem (HDFS). Understanding of how to process data in a distributed environment.
  
  
Databases: Strong proficiency in PostgreSQL.
  
  
Data Warehousing: Familiarity with modern Data Warehouse architectures (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, or generic Data Warehousing concepts).
  
  
Core Concepts: Conceptual clarity on Partitioning, Sharding, Distributed Computing, and Data Modeling.
  
  
Ability to distinguish when to use Classical ML (Regression, Classification, Clustering) vs. GenAI solutions.
  
  

* Business Intelligence & Analytics

Visualization Tools: Proficiency or strong familiarity with PowerBI, MicroStrategy, or similar BI tools.
  
  
Analytics Architecture: Understanding of OLAP Cubes and multi-dimensional data modeling.
  
  
ETL Tools: Awareness of ETL frameworks and tools like IBM DataStage or similar data integration platforms.
  
  

* Cloud & Tools

AWS: Basic awareness of EC2 and RDS.
  
  
DevOps Basics: Git (branching/merging) and Jira.
  
  
The "Vibe" & Soft Skills
  
  
Researcher Mindset: You are curious by nature. You don't just use tools; you want to understand how they work. You are comfortable writing technical content that explains "Why" we are using a specific technology.
  
  
Vibe Coding: You don't just write code; you get into the flow state. You are comfortable using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate development without losing understanding of the underlying logic.
  
  
Problem Solver: You love untangling complex logic and don't give up easily when code breaks.
  
  
Clear Communicator: You can explain complex AI concepts in simple terms.
  
  
Agile Mindset: Flexible, iterative, and open to feedback.

description:

Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
AuthMind is a pioneering Identity SecOps provider that arms identity and cybersecurity teams with end-to-end, real-time identity security posture management and threat detection. AuthMind is designed to secure identity and access in any cloud (e.g., AWS, Azure), as well as on-premises or data centres. In 2022, Gartner recognised AuthMind as a Cool Vendor in Identity-First Security. Read more at www.authmind.com.
  
  
Product
  
  
AuthMind discovers and monitors any identity that enterprise employees use to connect to any asset, anywhere, anytime. The AuthMind Identity SecOps Platform enables SecOps to address the most dangerous enablers of identity-based attacks: blind spots, identity infrastructure security gaps, and misconfigurations caused by human error. It allows security orgs to become enablers for engineering and business teams to move faster as they adopt new cloud and SaaS tooling.

Master's Degree

Experience in software development with a proven track record of delivering high-quality backend systems.

* [Mandatory - Systems Knowledge] Strong foundation in operating systems fundamentals, Linux, and distributed systems architecture.
* Extensive experience building and deploying scalable services in cloud environments.
* Exceptional analytical skills, capable of solving complex technical problems in high-scale systems.
* Commitment to providing exceptional support during on-call rotations and ensuring system reliability.
* Consistent emphasis on quality, testing, and documentation.

* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, rate limiting, and tenant isolation.

description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer
  
  
Location: Pune, India
  
  
**About The Role**
ComScore is a leading cross platform audience measurement company. We measure what matters to make audiences and advertising more valuable. We collect and process billions of events each day, have 10s of petabytes online and each month our processes read nearly an exabyte. We use this capability to provide our clients with unlocked insights into their data.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Product Data Engineering organization. This job involves designing and maintaining big data web & engineering solutions capable of running efficiently and robustly at petabyte scale.
  
  
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will own features and components end to end, contribute to technical design conversations, and begin to support the growth of engineers around you. You will work within a team but take responsibility for quality across the full lifecycle of your work.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the design and implementation of well-scoped features and system components, end to end
* Write production-quality code with minimal guidance, including tests, documentation, and observability
* Participate actively in code reviews, providing useful and constructive feedback to peers
* Use AI coding assistants fluently as part of your everyday development workflow — using them to draft, refactor, generate test cases, and explore approaches — while taking clear ownership of the code you ship
* Debug and resolve issues in production systems, including those you did not write
* Define data models which tie together large datasets from multiple data sources.
* Design, Implement and maintain Data pipelines and data driven solutions.
* Build data platform at scale using AWS and Snowflake to solve complex business use cases.
* Collaborate with DevOps, Release Management, Research and Operations teams
* Coordinate with external stakeholders to deliver on product requirements

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field
* 4 to 7 years of professional software engineering experience
* 3+ years developing software using Python, Java or Scala in Linux environment
* 3+ years Big Data Technologies – Cloud and/or On-Prem. AWS EMR or similar, Spark, Hadoop.
* Familiarity with Linux, shell scripting
* Strong SQL skills
* Ability to understand & improve enterprise software apps while factoring in overall design goals
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
* Fluency with AI development tools — able to use them efficiently across the development lifecycle, with sound judgment about when to rely on them and when to verify carefully

**Nice To Have**

* Hands-On experience with Snowflake or similar
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
* Experience in Scala
* Strong background in DevOps related practices (CI/CD, containerization, orchestration, infrastructure automation, etc.)
* Experience with agile development methodologies

**Benefits**

* Medical: Comscore offers a collective Private Medical Insurance scheme which is 100% covered by Comscore.
* The benefit is applicable to employees, an employee’s spouse, up to two children and parents.
* Pension: Provident Fund: Comscore bears both the employee and employer contribution.
* Time Off Annual Leave: Comscore offers market competitive annual leave of 26 Annual Leave
* Days (8 Casual and 18 Privilege), following local guidelines and practices.
* National Holidays and Festival Holidays: 10 Days.
* Sick Leave: 10 Days.
* Additional Leave: Paternity, Bereavement, Marriage, Maternity, Additional Pregnancy / Birth Related Leave
* Christmas / New Year Paid Leave, Comscore offers a week of Company paid leave over the Christmas / New Year period.
* Summer Hours: Comscore has a culture that rewards employees for their hard work. When you work hard, you need time to recharge and refresh. Early releases on Fridays are subject to manager approval.
* Internal Career Development Opportunities (minimum of 6 months tenure in the current position and in discussion with supervisors)
* Access to hundreds of professional e-learning courses, specifically created for Comscore
* Be creative: You don’t have to follow the norm to be successful – we encourage you to think outside the box. Our culture is built on encouraging innovative ideas, communication and joint success.
* Informal Work Atmosphere: We believe in getting the job done in a comfortable, casual environment!
* The ability to become a truly global engineer, with exposure to markets across the world. With more than 30 offices around the world, many Comscore teams work together across locations.

**About Comscore**
At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com.
  
  
Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
Qualys is building the future of cyber risk management with
**Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) -**
A platform that enables organizations to
**measure, communicate, and eliminate cyber risk**
across the enterprise.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer**
to operate at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this role, you will work directly with enterprise customers to onboard, integrate, and operationalize complex cybersecurity data into the Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will play a critical role in translating fragmented security environments into a unified, actionable risk model while providing real‑world feedback to product and engineering teams.
  
  
This is a hands‑on, customer‑facing role suited for engineers who thrive in ambiguous environments and enjoy solving complex, high‑impact problems at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
* Lead complex enterprise customer onboarding engagements, defining onboarding strategy and execution from planning through production rollout.
* Integrate multiple cybersecurity and business data sources into a unified asset and risk model, including vulnerability management, EDR/XDR, identity systems, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, penetration testing tools, CMDBs, and GRC platforms.
* Design and implement integrations for custom or new data sources using REST APIs, webhooks, and scalable ingestion pipelines (e.g., S3-based ingestion).
* Define and configure asset grouping, tagging, and asset criticality scoring aligned with customer business context.
* Customize assets and findings data models, including transformation and mapping logic, based on source-specific characteristics and customer use cases.
* Establish optimal onboarding sequencing to ensure a clean and reliable baseline for assets and findings.
* Implement robust asset and findings identification, correlation, and de‑duplication logic to prevent invalid merges across heterogeneous data sources.
* Ensure reliable, continuous, full and incremental data ingestion with appropriate scheduling, monitoring and error handling.
* Enable customers to use ETM as a single, authoritative system of record for assets, findings, and business context.
* Data Quality & Validation
* Validate data accuracy and integrity in collaboration with customers, partners, and internal teams to support trusted risk-based analytics.
* Design and maintain scalable frameworks for rapid data validation and quality assessment.
* Resolve data quality issues through controlled reprocessing and configuration improvements without disrupting existing integrations or metrics.
* Maintain high standards for data quality at both asset and findings levels to enable confident risk decision-making.
* Dashboards, Analytics & Risk Modeling
* Design and deliver advanced, customer-specific dashboards that surface meaningful trends and risk indicators.
* Enable complex composite risk scenarios, including toxic risk combinations, with accurate and actionable outcomes.
* Customize risk scoring, analytics, and visualizations to align with customer business and operational requirements.
* Response, Remediation & Reporting
* Configure scheduled alerts and automated responses using supported notification and response mechanisms.
* Integrate ETM with remediation and workflow platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, and similar systems, ensuring data consistency and reliability.
* Implement ownership, assignment, and escalation of workflows aligned with customer governance models.
* Build and deliver custom reports and metrics for executive, board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.
* Develop reusable utilities leveraging public APIs to support advanced reporting and analytics use cases.
* Product Feedback & Platform Evolution
* Act as a primary feedback loop between customers and ETM product and engineering teams.
* Identify recurring gaps in data models, workflows, and integrations based on real-world deployments.
* Influence platform roadmap priorities by translating customer needs into actionable product requirements.
* Collaborate cross‑functionally with product, engineering, and customer success teams.
* Support customers as they mature from visibility to prioritization, decision-making, and remediation-driven action.

**Qualifications**

* Required
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–7 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Strong programming experience in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable data ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Strong understanding of data modeling, normalization, and transformation.
* Hands-on experience applying AI or automation to improve onboarding, data processing, or operational workflows.
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity domains, including vulnerability management, cloud security, identity and access management, and risk frameworks.
* Experience working with relational, NoSQL, search, or graph-based data platforms.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Preferred
* Experience in forward-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or professional services roles.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices-based architectures.
* Comfort working in fast-paced, production environments with high customer impact.

**Job Description**
We are looking for an Amplitude Dashboard Build Analyst to rebuild Adobe Analytics reporting in Amplitude as part of a large-scale migration. You will take in-scope Adobe assets (segments, calculated metrics, Analysis Workspace projects, dashboards and scheduled reports) and rebuild them accurately in Amplitude by applying approved translation patterns, in prioritised waves, with consistent naming, ownership and governance. You will hand each asset to validation with evidence, and make sure market analysts can use it from day one.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Rebuild in-scope Adobe assets in Amplitude according to the per-asset disposition register and priority: cohorts, computed and derived properties, formulas, charts and dashboards.
* Apply the approved translation patterns for each asset class (e.g., segment to cohort, calculated metric to derived property or formula, Workspace project to dashboard and chart set), and raise cases where a pattern doesn’t fit instead of improvising.
* Work through assets by complexity band (low, medium, high), and give realistic effort estimates and early warning on assets that are harder than banded.
* Build global standard dashboards once as templates with market-filtered views, and market-specific reports where consolidation isn’t possible.
* Apply naming, ownership, folder and governance conventions consistently, and document each rebuilt asset (source Adobe asset, Amplitude construct, logic, known differences).
* Reproduce Adobe logic accurately in Amplitude, including segment definitions, metric formulas, time windows, attribution and persistence behaviour, and call out where the logic cannot be reproduced for the gap register.
* Check each rebuilt asset against the Adobe source before handover, and provide inputs to the parity evidence pack (queries, screenshots, numbers, known variances).
* Fix defects raised in parity validation and owner review, and re-submit with notes.
* Rebuild scheduled and exported reporting in Amplitude scheduled reports or hand over to the lakehouse/BI team where the pattern calls for it.
* Work with market analysts and report owners to clarify requirements, confirm acceptance and capture workarounds that should become proper assets.
* Support market enablement by contributing worked examples, crosswalk entries and answers to analyst questions during training and office hours.
* Report throughput and quality per wave (assets completed per sprint, first-time-right rate, rework) and flag slippage in the sprint it occurs.
* Use available automation (scripts, bulk creation through APIs) as provided, and suggest where repeated manual steps could be automated.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5-7 years in digital analytics, web/product analytics or BI reporting, with significant hands-on experience building dashboards and reports.
* Strong hands-on Amplitude experience: cohorts, funnels, retention, user journeys, charts, dashboards, derived and computed properties, formulas and event/property taxonomy.
* Strong working knowledge of Adobe Analytics: segments, calculated metrics, Analysis Workspace, eVars/props/events, classifications and report suites, enough to read and interpret existing assets.
* Good understanding of how metrics differ between the two platforms (sessions, attribution, persistence, unique counts, events vs properties).
* Strong SQL skills for checking numbers against raw event data (Databricks or similar).
* Attention to detail and a disciplined approach to documentation, naming and versioning.
* Experience working to defined patterns, tolerances and acceptance criteria, in sprint or wave-based delivery.
* Clear communication with business users and technical teams, including explaining why a number differs.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience on a reporting or analytics migration, preferably from Adobe to Amplitude.
* Python for light automation and use of Amplitude or Adobe APIs.
* Experience with Power BI or another BI tool for reports that belong outside Amplitude.
* Experience with market or region-scoped dashboards and role-based access.

title: Manager Group Demand Planning
description:
**Company Description**
DÖHLER – WE BRING IDEAS TO LIFE.®
  
  
Döhler is a global producer, marketer and provider of technology-driven natural ingredients, ingredient systems and integrated solutions for the global food, beverage and life science & nutrition industry. Döhler is all about mastering sensory experience and nutritional performance. Being sustainable by nature, Döhler helps to nourish the world better: Good for people – Good for planet.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Data Scientist – Demand Planning & Supply Chain Analytics (m/f/d) is part of the Demand Planning function within Global Business Services (GBS) and is responsible for developing and improving data-driven forecasting, planning, and decision-support solutions for the assigned portfolio.
  
  
The role combines advanced analytics, statistical modelling, and machine learning with business understanding to improve forecast accuracy, supply chain visibility, service levels, inventory performance, and planning efficiency — with particular focus on continuously improving the statistical (base) demand forecast that underpins Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP/IBP).
  
  
The position acts as a bridge between Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders by translating complex data into actionable insights and scalable analytical solutions.
  
  
The role has no disciplinary responsibility and reports to the Manager Demand Planning.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Your Responsibilities
  
  

* Demand Forecasting & Advanced Analytics
* Develop, maintain, and improve statistical forecasting and machine-learning models for demand planning.
* Integrate statistical forecasts with market intelligence, customer information, commercial input, promotions, and business assumptions.
* Analyze historical demand, trends, seasonality, outliers, demand variability, and forecast bias.
* Identify the key drivers influencing demand and quantify their impact on forecast performance.
* Evaluate and improve forecasting approaches through back-testing, scenario analysis, and model benchmarking.
* Monitor forecast accuracy, forecast value added (FVA), bias, and other relevant planning KPIs.
* Challenge forecast figures from the business, other regions, and intercompany sources using data-driven insights.
* Support the definition and implementation of Make-to-Stock, Make-to-Order, or related supply strategies through analytical recommendations.
* Develop demand scenarios, sensitivity analyses, and risk assessments to support tactical and strategic decision-making.
* Multi-Source Demand Signal Analysis & Reconciliation
* Provide the analytical basis for combining multiple demand signal types into one coherent base forecast, including contracted/committed volumes, Lead-to-Order (LTO) pipeline volumes, customer-specific forecasts, and material-level statistical forecasts.
* Analyze and quantify the certainty, time horizon, and granularity differences between demand signal types, and provide data-driven recommendations to support the design and calibration of the demand hierarchy/waterfall logic owned by Demand Planning.
* Identify and flag inconsistencies, double-counting, or gaps between top-down (customer/portfolio) and bottom-up (material/SKU) demand layers, and provide analysis to support their resolution.
* Analyze historical LTO pipeline conversion behavior (e.g., conversion rates, typical phase-in timing) to support appropriate probability-weighting of pipeline volumes relative to contracted volumes.
* Analyze historical patterns of how annual/yearly contract volumes split into monthly (or other sub-annual) quantities, to improve the time-phasing accuracy of contracted demand.
* Analyze and document how incoming customer orders consume the statistical/base forecast over time (forecast consumption logic), and identify opportunities to improve its accuracy and transparency.
* Analyze how push-driven (“crop-driven”) business — volume determined by raw material availability/harvest timing rather than pull demand — is incorporated into the forecast, and run dedicated analytics to improve its treatment and accuracy.
* Data Preparation & Quality Management
* Ensure the quality, consistency, and completeness of demand, customer, material, sales, inventory, and supply chain data.
* Perform history cleansing and establish robust processes for identifying and treating outliers, one-off events, stock-outs, and exceptional demand.
* Support the integration of new customers, materials, products, flows, and data sources into IBP and related planning systems.
* Manage and improve statistical forecast parameters, including model selection, aggregation levels, time horizons, and forecast frequencies.
* Monitor data pipelines and investigate data inconsistencies affecting planning outputs.
* Establish standards for data preparation, documentation, version control, and reproducible analysis.
* Business Partnership & Decision Support
* Translate business questions and planning challenges into analytical requirements and practical data science solutions.
* Interface with Sales, Account Management, Business Units, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Controlling, and Operations on forecasting and planning topics.
* Support the analysis of business complaints relating to forecasts and new product introductions.
* Collaborate with Sales and R&D to obtain and validate LTO pipeline data at the appropriate stage of maturity for inclusion in the combined demand forecast.
* Analyze open contract quantities against call-offs and forecast figures in collaboration with Account Managers and business stakeholders.
* Support the development of a single, aligned forecast across Sales, Finance, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer collaboration and create longer-term visibility of customer demand.
* Present analytical findings, assumptions, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships and promote data-driven decision-making across the organization.
* Strategic Planning & Modelling
* Develop future demand projection models to support the five-year planning process.
* Support tactical and strategic demand planning for regional capacity analysis and capacity-related conclusions.
* Perform product and customer lifecycle analysis, including new product introductions, phase-ins/phase-outs, portfolio changes, and monitoring relevant system and master-data changes.
* Support business scenario planning, including demand upside/downside scenarios, supply constraints, customer changes, and market risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and process improvement in demand planning and IBP.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and self-service analytical tools for planning and business stakeholders.
* Ensure analytical solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business and IT standards.

**Qualifications**

* Completed degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Applied Economics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable quantitative field.
* 3–5 years of professional experience in data science, advanced analytics, demand planning, supply chain analytics, forecasting, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in statistical forecasting, time-series analysis, predictive modelling, and trend analysis.
* Practical experience applying machine-learning techniques to business or supply chain problems.
* Strong programming skills in Python or R.
* Good knowledge of SQL and experience working with structured and large-scale datasets.
* Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent.
* Sound understanding of demand planning, IBP/S&OP, supply chain processes, inventory management, and forecast performance measurement.
* Experience working with ERP, APS, IBP, or planning systems an advantage.
* Knowledge of cloud data platforms, APIs, data pipelines, or MLOps desirable.
* Experience combining or reconciling demand signals of differing certainty and granularity (e.g., contracted volumes, pipeline/opportunity data, customer-level and material-level forecasts) an advantage.

Personal Competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of data quality, data governance, and model validation principles
* Ability to explain complex analytical results in a clear and commercially relevant manner
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a customer-centric approach
* Ability to critically challenge assumptions and translate findings into business actions
* Strong team player with well-developed interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills
* Ability to work effectively across Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and regional teams

title: Data Modeling Analyst - Azure Databricks
description:
Dear Candidate,

**Greetings from AkzoNobel (Experts in the proud craft of making paints and coatings since 1792)**

We're looking for a business-facing
**Data Modeling Analyst**
to act as the bridge between our stakeholders and our data & engineering teams. You'll sit in the middle layer: understanding business needs, translating them into clear technical requirements, and designing the data models and specifications that enable robust enterprise reporting and analytics.

This is a hybrid between a data modeler and a business analyst hands-on with SQL and data profiling, but also leading conversations with the business to shape what we build at an enterprise level. You won't be building reports or dashboards yourself; you'll be defining the models and specs that make sure the people who do can build them right, the first time.

**Mandatory Skills - Azure Databricks, Data Modelling, SQL, Stakeholder Management, Design, Requirement Gathering etc**

**What you'll do**

**Business & requirements**

* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand goals, KPIs, and processes.
* Lead workshops and interviews to gather and structure reporting/analytics requirements.
* Translate business needs into precise functional and technical requirements.
* Define and maintain business definitions for core entities, metrics, and KPIs.

**Data modelling & design**

* Design logical and physical data models for the enterprise reporting layer (e.g., star schemas, dimensional models, semantic entities).
* Create and maintain source-to-target mappings and transformation specifications.
* Define data contracts and interface specifications between source systems, the warehouse, and BI layers.
* Work closely with data engineers and BI developers so that models are implemented correctly and efficiently.

**Hands-on data work (SQL & analysis)**

* Use SQL to explore and profile source data, validate assumptions, and assess data quality.
* Write SQL to prototype data transformations and models (e.g., views, CTEs, dbt models, or the equivalent in our stack).
* Trace metrics and attributes end-to-end: from business definition to underlying source fields and logic.
* Support engineers and BI developers with clear specifications, test cases, and acceptance criteria.

**Governance, quality & documentation**

* Own functional and technical documentation for your domains (definitions, models, mappings, logic).
* Help establish and enforce standards for modeling, naming, and metric definitions.
* Contribute to data quality rules and acceptance tests for critical datasets.
* Act as the subject-matter expert for "what our data means" and "how it should be modeled."

**What you'll bring**

**Must-haves**

* Experience in a BI / analytics-oriented role (e.g., BI Analyst, Analytics Engineer, Data Modeler, Functional Analyst, or similar).
* Strong SQL skills; comfortable with complex joins, aggregations, and investigative queries.
* Practical experience designing data models for analytics and reporting (dimensional/star schema, fact/dimension concepts, slowly changing dimensions, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to gather and refine business requirements and convert them into technical specs and models.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to talk to both business stakeholders and technical teams.
* A proactive, hands-on mindset you take ownership, ask questions, and drive clarity rather than waiting for perfect input.
* Experience with enterprise data warehouses and modern cloud platforms (e.g., Databricks).

**Nice-to-haves (adapt to your environment)**

* Familiarity with data modeling tools (e.g., ER/Studio, Erwin, dbt docs, Lucidchart, etc.).
* Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and how pipelines support your models (without necessarily building the pipelines yourself).
* Experience in manufacturing and knowledge of common KPIs and data domains.

**What success looks like**

* Stakeholders see their needs accurately reflected in data models and validated datasets.
* Data engineers and BI developers have clear, unambiguous specifications and models to build from.
* Core entities and metrics are consistently defined, reducing rework and misinterpretation.
* You become the go-to person for how things should be modelled and what the data really means.

**Regards,**

**Team AkzoNobel**

It allows security organizations to become enablers for engineering and business teams to move faster as they adopt new cloud and SaaS tooling.
  
  
The product is heavily driven by data analytics as well as AI/ML. The core idea is to analyze events & logs from enterprise systems & networks to enable the use cases we are trying to solve in the area of identity & access security.

This role combines deep technical expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, and large-scale data processing with strong engineering and technical leadership. You will work on analyzing billions of events, flows, logs, and other security data to build intelligent capabilities that help customers understand their security posture, identify risks, detect anomalies, and derive actionable insights.
  
  
You will own the end-to-end technical direction and delivery of Data Science/ML components, from problem formulation and algorithm development through productionization, scalability, performance, and ongoing improvement.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role in a fast-moving startup environment, requiring a balance of technical depth, product thinking, execution, and team leadership.

title: Software Developer - AuthMind
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world's leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM's product and technology landscape. Here, you'l have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
AuthMind discovers and monitors any identity that enterprise employees use to connect to any asset, anywhere, anytime. The AuthMind Identity SecOps Platform enables SecOps to address the most dangerous enablers of identity-based attacks: blind spots, identity infrastructure security gaps, and misconfigurations caused by human error. It allows security orgs to become enablers for engineering and business teams to move faster as they adopt new cloud and SaaS tooling.
  
  
The product is heavily driven by data analytics as well as AI/ML. The core idea is to analyse events & logs from enterprise systems & networks to enable the use cases we are trying to solve in the area of identity & access security.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer with 3 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic and fast-paced engineering team. The ideal candidate is technically adept, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and has a proven track record of building and scaling backend services. You will play a critical role in designing and delivering high-performance, secure systems for solving some of the most challenging problems in identity security while mentoring others and driving engineering excellence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and implement backend services with a strong emphasis on scalability, performance, and reliability.
* Lead the development of distributed systems in cloud environments, ensuring robust and secure deployments.
* Leverage deep expertise in at least one programming language (Golang, Python, or C/C++) to solve complex technical challenges.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* Analyze and optimize system interactions within the Linux environment, ensuring efficient resource utilization.
* Address large-scale data engineering challenges, implementing solutions for efficient data processing and transformation.
* Drive engineering best practices, including robust testing, clean code, documentation, and efficient deployment pipelines.
* Ensure efficient use of cloud resources to minimize costs while maintaining performance and reliability.
* Support customers via on-call rotations in engineering to ensure prompt issue resolution and system reliability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements.
* Adapt quickly to shifting priorities and technologies, contributing to the success of a dynamic, high-growth company.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong hands-on experience in Go.
* Proven experience building and running high-volume, distributed services in a SaaS or cloud environment.
* Solid grasp of Go concurrency (goroutines, channels, contexts), testing, and idiomatic design.
* Experience designing RESTful and/or gRPC APIs and microservice architectures.
* Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL data stores, plus messaging or streaming systems.
* Experience with observability tooling and production troubleshooting.
* Understanding of secure development practices and of compliance requirements for SaaS, such as SOC 2 and GDPR.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, and a track record of mentoring others.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, rate limiting, and tenant isolation.
* Experience with event-driven design and data consistency patterns at scale.
* Familiarity with service meshes, feature flags, and progressive delivery.
* Contributions to open source projects.
* Experience with load and chaos testing.

Pathlock’s Professional Services organization builds and maintains internal enterprise web applications that support our Professional Services teams and customers. These are data-driven, form-heavy web applications built with React + TypeScript (Vite), a Node.js (TypeScript) REST API, and a Microsoft SQL Server database using row-level security.

We are looking for a mid-senior Full-Stack Developer who will own features end to end – from database to UI and contribute to design decisions alongside the solution architect. You will help shape and deliver the product roadmap as these applications continue to grow in scope and capability. The team embraces AI-assisted development to deliver faster and work smarter.

* **Front end:**
  Build and extend the UI, including dynamic schema-driven forms, conditional fields, repeatable tables, validation, progress tracking, export and print/PDF output.
* **APIs:**
  Build secure Node.js REST APIs (Express, Fastify or NestJS) using parameterized queries and transactional header/detail upserts.
* **Database:**
  Design and evolve the SQL Server schema, stored procedures, views, row-level security policies and migration scripts.
* **Security:**
  Implement authentication and authorization: OTP login, session management, role-based personas, staff vs. customer access and least-privilege database permissions.
* **Deployment:**
  Deploy and manage the application on IIS (IIS as a reverse proxy with URL Rewrite + ARR, Node.js running as a Windows service, web.config, bindings/SSL) and help plan the move toward Azure.
* **Roadmap delivery:**
  Own and ship new roadmap features end to end, from requirements and data model through API, UI and release.
* **Quality:**
  Write unit, integration and end-to-end tests; participate in code reviews; contribute to CI/CD pipelines and technical documentation.
* **Mentoring:**
  Guide and mentor junior developers through pairing, reviews and knowledge sharing.
* **AI-assisted development:**
  Use AI coding assistants and agents (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT/Claude) to accelerate design, coding, refactoring, testing and documentation, while reviewing all AI-generated code for correctness, security and maintainability.
* **AI for efficiency:**
  Identify opportunities to apply AI/LLM capabilities within our applications and workflows (e.g. drafting content, summarizing inputs, smart validation) to improve efficiency for Professional Services teams and customers.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Experience:**
  4-8 years of professional full-stack development experience.
* **Front end:**
  React 18+ with hooks or Vue 3 (Composition API), strict TypeScript, Vite, modern CSS and complex form handling.
* **SQL Server:**
  Understanding of T-SQL, relational schema, stored procedures, views, functions, etc
* **Security:**
  OWASP Top 10, SQL injection prevention, authentication patterns, secrets management and least-privilege design.
* **Infrastructure & tools:**
  IIS on Windows Server, PowerShell and Git.
* **AI tools:**
  Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day development, with strong judgment on prompting, verifying output and safeguarding code and data (no secrets or customer data in prompts).

**NICE TO HAVE**

* **IGA domain:**
  Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML), provisioning, access requests, user access reviews/certifications, SoD/access risk, firefighter/emergency access; experience with Pathlock, SAP GRC, SailPoint or Saviynt.
* **Front end:**
  Vite, modern CSS and complex form handling.
* **Back end:**
  Node.js 20+ LTS with TypeScript; REST API frameworks such as Express, Fastify or NestJS; SQL Server access via mssql/tedious or an ORM/query builder such as Prisma, TypeORM or Knex; async programming, modular architecture; npm/pnpm.
* **SQL Server:**
  Strong T-SQL, schema design, indexing, SQL Server RLS / SESSION\_CONTEXT; logins, users and permissions (including orphaned users); backup and restore.
* **Business applications:**
  SAP security / S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Workday or Active Directory integrations.
* **AI/LLM integration:**
  Building features with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI or similar), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluating AI output quality.

**SOFT SKILLS**

* Translates consultant and customer needs into clean data models and simple, intuitive UX.
* Communicates clearly with Professional Services teams and customers.
* Writes good, maintainable documentation.
* Takes ownership of features from database to UI.
* Enjoys mentoring and raising the bar for the team.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THE FIRST 6 MONTHS**

* Deliver new features end to end (schema, API, UI, tests).
* Automate builds and deployments through CI/CD pipelines.
* Meaningfully increase unit, integration and E2E test coverage.
* Contribute to technical design decisions, including the path toward Azure.
* Establish AI-assisted development practices for the team (guidelines, reusable prompts, code-review checks) that measurably shorten delivery time.

**EDUCATION**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced application developer with
**7+ years of software development experience**
and advanced hands-on expertise in
**React, Azure cloud technologies, RESTful Web APIs and Microsoft SQL Server**
. You will lead technical delivery for secure, scalable and business-critical applications, taking ownership of complex development activities from solution design through deployment and production support.
  
  
This role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, customer engagement, code and design reviews, mentoring, incident resolution and collaboration across Agile product and technology teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the design, development, enhancement and maintenance of secure, scalable, enterprise-grade applications using modern software engineering practices
* Translate solution designs into implementable components and take ownership of complex development activities
* Develop clean, maintainable and efficient code aligned with established architecture, security and engineering standards
* Lead code reviews, design reviews and quality checks, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to development standards
* Mentor junior developers through knowledge sharing, pair programming, technical guidance and development support
* Act as a technical point of contact for customers and stakeholders, communicating solution options, progress, dependencies, risks and technical issues clearly
* Participate in customer discussions, requirements clarification, solution walkthroughs, demonstrations, incidents and service-review meetings
* Perform unit testing and support integration, system and user acceptance testing, deployment, releases and post-deployment activities
* Troubleshoot complex application defects, production incidents and performance issues, undertaking root-cause analysis and implementing sustainable corrective actions
* Design and develop responsive user interfaces using React and modern front-end technologies
* Develop and consume RESTful Web APIs and integration services
* Design, optimise and maintain reliable application data solutions using Microsoft SQL Server
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Architects, QA Engineers, operations teams and business stakeholders to deliver agreed outcomes
* Contribute to Agile ceremonies, estimation, technical planning, continuous improvement and engineering best practices
* Use Azure DevOps and GitHub for source control, work-item tracking, CI/CD, release management and engineering governance
* Assess relevant emerging technologies and development practices to support evolving customer and business requirements

**Who You Are**

* You have 7+ years of application development experience, including responsibility for complex or business-critical solutions
* You have advanced, hands-on experience with React and modern front-end technologies
* You have substantial experience designing, developing and consuming RESTful Web APIs and integration services
* You have strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, relational database design, query optimisation and performance troubleshooting
* You have experience with Azure DevOps and GitHub, including source control, CI/CD, work management and release governance
* You understand the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), secure coding practices, unit testing, automated quality controls, deployment and production support
* You have demonstrated experience in technical leadership, design and code reviews, estimation and end-to-end delivery ownership
* You have experience mentoring junior developers through coaching and knowledge sharing
* You can investigate complex application issues and have experience with incident management, root-cause analysis and technical troubleshooting
* You can communicate technical concepts confidently to customers and senior stakeholders and collaborate effectively across business and technology teams
* You have substantial experience working within Agile development teams
* Exposure to Microsoft Power Platform is desirable
* Knowledge of relevant Microsoft Azure services is preferred
* Knowledge of GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) is an added advantage

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Work on secure, scalable and business-critical enterprise applications spanning React, Azure, APIs and Microsoft SQL Server
* Take end-to-end technical ownership across design, development, testing, deployment and production support
* Build technical leadership experience through mentoring, design reviews, code reviews and engineering decision-making
* Collaborate directly with customers, architects, product teams, QA and operations stakeholders
* Gain exposure to modern engineering practices including CI/CD, Agile delivery, secure development and engineering governance
* Explore emerging technologies and development practices as customer and business requirements evolve

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Enterprise-scale React application architecture and modern front-end engineering
* Azure cloud application development and associated services
